name: _Display Results in Virtual List
purpose: Displays the results list in the virtual-list layout: clears the found set, sorts rows (client first, name, number), sets the status text 'Found n phone(s)' and goes to the search field.

name: Select Phone
purpose: Puts the selected row (ContactId, Phone, PhoneId) into Picker::Results as JSON and closes the picker window.
